AnalysisFinding.description: One judgment. It is an AI/heuristic opinion, never a fact: it must cite stored records and always needs human review.
AnalysisFinding.title: AnalysisFinding

ArtifactCreate.description: Registers delivery evidence. Server-decided fields (hash of content, ingestion time, version, ids) cannot be supplied.
ArtifactCreate.title: ArtifactCreate

BaselineCreate.description: Freezes the ORIGINAL agreement. The version, kind and owner are decided by the server.
BaselineCreate.title: BaselineCreate

BaselineView.description: An immutable, versioned snapshot of what was agreed. `content_sha256` covers the requirements only.
BaselineView.title: BaselineView

BuyerAuthenticatorView.description: What the seller may see: that a second channel exists, never the secret and never the full address.

note.default: Operator-established second channel for a demo; this is not verified real-world identity, and it is not independent of the seller if the seller is also the operator.
note.title: Note

BuyerAuthenticatorView.title: BuyerAuthenticatorView

BuyerDecision.description: Distinct buyer acts. Acknowledging receipt is not accepting the work, and neither is a payment dispute.
BuyerDecision.title: BuyerDecision

BuyerDecisionView.description: Append-only record of a decision made by the holder of a verified e-mail address (identity beyond that is NOT verified).
BuyerDecisionView.title: BuyerDecisionView

BuyerRequestCreate.description: Asks an e-mail address to decide. The link and the code go to that mailbox only; the seller never receives them.
BuyerRequestCreate.title: BuyerRequestCreate

CaseCitation.description: A pointer to a stored record of the SAME project. `source`/`confidence`/`payload_sha256` are set for observations.
CaseCitation.title: CaseCitation

ContentVerification.description: What the server can honestly say about an artifact's bytes. A hash never proves authorship, creation time or receipt.
ContentVerification.title: ContentVerification

DeliveryStatus.description: Derived from the buyer's LATEST verified delivery decision. Never stored, never settable by a client.
DeliveryStatus.title: DeliveryStatus

DiagnosisResponse.description: Advisory only. It cannot approve, execute or alter anything; recovery guards decide what may happen.

authority.default: Diagnosis is advisory text for a human. It never approves, previews, executes or changes a recovery, never contacts a provider and never moves funds. Merchant-side facts are simulated; provider facts carry their own provenance label.
authority.title: Authority

DiagnosisResponse.title: DiagnosisResponse

HoldStatus.description: A hold blocks operations performed through Caligo only. It never freezes or redirects funds held by PayPal.
HoldStatus.title: HoldStatus

InstructionChangeForBuyer.description: Rendered by the server from stored rows (never from seller-typed text) so the approver sees exactly what would be applied.

trust_note.default: The second channel was established by the operator for this demo; it is not verified real-world identity and is not independent of the seller if the seller is also the operator. The current values may themselves be an unverified seller entry (version 1 is never independently verified).
trust_note.title: Trust Note

InstructionChangeForBuyer.title: InstructionChangeForBuyer

note.default: Authorized by an operator-established second channel; this is not verified real-world identity, not proof of independence from the seller, and version 1 of the instruction remains unverified.
note.title: Note

inputs_provenance.default: configuration and heartbeat are caller-reported simulation inputs at the assessment time; the transaction proof is a provider-PAID payment whose merchant order the safe processor applied, and it expires with the freshness window
inputs_provenance.title: Inputs Provenance

InvoiceRequest.description: No provider status, project status or owner can be supplied: unknown fields are rejected.
InvoiceRequest.title: InvoiceRequest

LogIntelligenceResponse.description: Advisory only. Log hypotheses are untrusted language clues, never verified payment facts; nothing here changes any record.

authority.default: Advisory text for a human. Log-derived hypotheses are untrusted and are not payment facts; exact candidates are unverified. Nothing here approves, previews, executes or changes a recovery, contacts a provider or moves funds.
authority.title: Authority

LogIntelligenceResponse.title: LogIntelligenceResponse

LogLine.description: One untrusted log line. Ids, scope, provenance and timestamps are assigned by the server, never taken from the caller.
LogLine.title: LogLine

note.default: Every row is an unverified merchant claim. Importing changes no payment status, verifies no payment and releases no payment-instruction hold.
note.title: Note

authority.default: Payment status is decided only by provider reconciliation. Merchant-ledger claims are shown beside provider evidence for comparison; they never confirm a payment, change a status or release a hold.
authority.title: Authority

OperationState.description: Local state of an in-flight or interrupted provider operation (crash/ambiguity recovery).
OperationState.title: OperationState

PayeeScreenRequest.description: Read-only screening input. Every field is a claim to be checked, none is trusted.
PayeeScreenRequest.title: PayeeScreenRequest

PayeeScreenResponse.description: Advisory only. There is deliberately no approved/cleared outcome: a screen cannot release a hold or authorize a payment.

authority.default: Advisory text for a human. It writes nothing, cannot approve, clear, release or override a payment hold, and does not verify a destination: independent verification is the buyer-side second-channel check (R2).
authority.title: Authority

PayeeScreenResponse.title: PayeeScreenResponse

PayeeVersionView.description: One append-only registry version. SELLER_ASSERTED: the seller's own record, never provider or buyer evidence and never a verification.
PayeeVersionView.title: PayeeVersionView

PaymentInstructionCreate.description: The payee is the provider's configured merchant, never free text: a client cannot name a different account here.
PaymentInstructionCreate.title: PaymentInstructionCreate

PaymentLink.description: Server-produced payment summary. Every financial field is derived from provider evidence.
PaymentLink.title: PaymentLink

PaymentObservationView.description: One recorded observation. `confidence` says what it is worth: only PROVIDER_EVIDENCE came from the provider.
PaymentObservationView.title: PaymentObservationView

PaymentProviderName.description:
Which backend produced a payment record. MOCK_PAYPAL is never a real transaction;
PAYPAL_SANDBOX is PayPal's test environment, never real money. PAYPAL (live) is not implemented.
PaymentProviderName.title: PaymentProviderName

PaymentProviderStatus.description:
Financial state derived ONLY from verified provider evidence by the reconciliation path.
Never accepted from a client.
PaymentProviderStatus.title: PaymentProviderStatus

ProjectDraft.description: Client input. The owning seller is derived from the session, never the body.
ProjectDraft.title: ProjectDraft

ProviderInvoiceState.description: PayPal Invoicing v2 invoice lifecycle status (what the provider reports, not proof of payment).
ProviderInvoiceState.title: ProviderInvoiceState

RecoveryCase.description:
One evidence-cited, advisory recovery case. It is computed from stored records on every read and stored nowhere:
nothing here changes a payment, a status, a hold or any evidence, and Caligo takes none of the recommended steps itself.

default: Issue, approve or request a refund
Cancel, void, send or modify a PayPal invoice
Mark a payment as paid or verified because of a merchant or seller claim
Release, override or bypass a payment-instruction hold
Edit or delete stored observations, gaps or history
prohibited_automated_actions.title: Prohibited Automated Actions

RecoveryCase.title: RecoveryCase

authority.default: Recovery cases are advisory. They are derived from stored provider observations, unverified merchant claims, reconciliation records and instruction records; they never change a payment, release a hold or promote a claim to provider evidence, and Caligo performs none of the recommended steps.
authority.title: Authority

RecoveryPlanApprove.description: Approval binds to exactly one plan version and its evidence fingerprint; it can never authorize a changed plan.
RecoveryPlanApprove.title: RecoveryPlanApprove

RegistrationAck.description: Identical for new and already-registered emails (no account enumeration).
RegistrationAck.title: RegistrationAck

ReviewResolutionRequest.description: Leaving NEEDS_REVIEW is always an explicit seller decision with a recorded reason.
ReviewResolutionRequest.title: ReviewResolutionRequest

ScopeChangeCreate.description: A PROPOSED change. Nothing here can approve it: approval exists only as verified buyer evidence.
ScopeChangeCreate.title: ScopeChangeCreate

ScopeRecordView.description: Append-only source record. `source_sha256` is computed by the server over `content`.
ScopeRecordView.title: ScopeRecordView

ScreenExtracted.description: Literal text matches only; null where the text does not state the field. Never verified.
ScreenExtracted.title: ScreenExtracted

SellerObservationCreate.description: A single claim typed by the seller. The source is always SELLER_ENTRY: it is not a request field.
SellerObservationCreate.title: SellerObservationCreate

note.default: Recorded as an unverified seller claim. It does not change any payment status or release any hold.
note.title: Note

SendInvoiceRequest.description: Sending emails the recipient through PayPal, so the seller must re-type the stored address.
SendInvoiceRequest.title: SendInvoiceRequest
